title: Design a Customer-Support Assistant
summary: A full interview-style design of a support assistant for a large online retailer: grounded answers from the help centre, account actions through tools, and a clean hand-off to human agents, with every number estimated.
objectives: Turn a vague support-bot brief into requirements, SLOs and a token and cost estimate
Draw the architecture and trace one customer turn end to end, from message to grounded answer
Estimate answer accuracy from retrieval recall and generator faithfulness, and size the help-centre index
Reason about containment, false resolution and tool permissions in money, not only in quality scores
Defend the main trade-offs (model size, routing, autonomy, hand-off) the way an interviewer expects
prerequisites: Work through [A Framework for LLM System Design](/learn/llm-system-design/design-framework) first. It also helps to know [how RAG works](/learn/retrieval-and-rag/rag-architecture), [function calling](/learn/prompt-and-context/tools-and-functions) and [bounded autonomy for agents](/learn/agents/bounded-autonomy).
